params.name: key
params.description: Your WeatherAPI.com API key.

params.name: q
params.description: Location query. Accepts: city name, lat/lon, US zip, UK postcode, Canada postal code, METAR code (metar:EGLL), IATA (iata:DXB), auto:ip, IPv4/IPv6, or location ID (id:2801268).

params.name: aqi
params.description: Include Air Quality Index (AQI) data in response.

params.name: pollen
params.description: Include pollen data. Available on Pro+ and above.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language code for condition text. E.g.: fr, de, es, zh, ar. See full list in docs.

params.name: current_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return in the current element, e.g. temp_c,wind_mph.

items.docs: Returns up-to-date current weather for a given location. Data is refreshed every 10–15 minutes. Optionally includes air quality (AQI) and pollen data.

params.name: key
params.description: Your WeatherAPI.com API key.

params.name: q
params.description: Location query. Accepts: city name, lat/lon, US zip, UK postcode, Canada postal code, METAR code (metar:EGLL), IATA (iata:DXB), auto:ip, IPv4/IPv6, or location ID (id:2801268).

params.name: days
params.description: Number of forecast days (1–14).

params.name: dt
params.description: Restrict date output in yyyy-MM-dd format.

params.name: unixdt
params.description: Unix timestamp equivalent of `dt`. Do not pass both.

params.name: hour
params.description: Restrict output to a specific hour (0–23) in 24-hour format.

params.name: alerts
params.description: Include weather alerts in Forecast API response.

params.name: aqi
params.description: Include Air Quality Index (AQI) data in response.

params.name: pollen
params.description: Include pollen data. Available on Pro+ and above.

params.name: tp
params.description: Interval for data. Use tp=15 for 15-minute intervals (Enterprise only).

params.name: lang
params.description: Language code for condition text. E.g.: fr, de, es, zh, ar. See full list in docs.

params.name: day_fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return in forecast/history day element.

params.name: hour_fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return in forecast/history hour element.

params.name: et0
params.description: Include evapotranspiration data. Business and Enterprise only.

items.docs: Returns weather forecast for up to 14 days (plan dependent). Includes hourly intervals, astronomy, air quality, pollen, and weather alerts.

items.docs: Retrieve current weather for multiple locations in a single request. Pass `q=bulk` in the query string with a JSON body containing up to 50 locations. Each location counts as 1 call. Available on Pro+, Business, and Enterprise plans.
